fact: AKADEMIYA2063, with the national agricultural research institute INRAB and farmer platform PNOPPA, developed the AAgWa platform of satellite-based crop statistics and yield forecasts for Benin, launched at a virtual event on 7 October 2025.

INRAB, the national agricultural research institute, with CIRAD built a Random Forest model on satellite vegetation-index series to map farming systems in northern and central Benin, reaching 60% accuracy with radiometric and geographic variables combined.
